'''Dol''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. Following the [[Invasion of Ziost]], he served on [[Darth Marr's flagship]] during the excursion into the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] in an attempt to locate [[Tenebrae|Vitiate]], the former [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]], alongside [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] soldiers. During the mission, Marr's flagship was [[Destruction of Darth Marr's flagship|attacked]] by the [[Eternal Fleet]], which deployed [[Skytrooper]]s onboard through the [[Boarding pod/Legends|boarding pods]]. When a group of Republic soldiers got cut off from the main force, Dol ordered to shut the blast door between them, to which Republic Corporal [[Ralo]] objected. At the end of the battle, the vessel Dol was on was destroyed, though Dol was among some soldiers, such as Ralo, who made it out in the escape pods.<ref name="SWTOR" /> Ralo confirmed his and Dol's survival via a written message to the individual who became the future [[Alliance Commander]].<ref name="SWTOR" /> 

==Behind the scenes==
Sergeant Dol appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' '''Chapter 1: The Hunt'''. He is voiced by [[Nolan North]].
